packageRules.description: Keep devEngines version ranges instead of pinning them, as the pinAllExceptPeerDependencies preset (in config:js-app) exempts engines but not devEngines. Remove once the preset is fixed: https://github.com/renovatebot/renovate/discussions/46989
Update the lockfile with npm 11, because npm 12 fails on packages with bundled dependencies. Remove once fixed: https://github.com/npm/cli/issues/9800
